# Liberty Park Dental

> > A comprehensive dental practice in Liberty, Missouri led by Dr. James J. Dixson, offering cosmetic, preventative, restorative, and specialized dental services including implants, laser therapy, and sleep apnea treatment.

Liberty Park Dental is a full-service dental practice serving the Liberty, MO community with a focus on personalized patient care. The practice offers advanced technologies including CEREC crowns, 3D guided implantology, and laser therapy, alongside traditional dental services for families and individuals.
